data.exact_reserve_text: During the year there was an overall negative net run-off development of GBP 23,233,000 (2013 GBP 17,262,000 positive) of which the major contributor was third party liability of GBP 20,420,000 adverse (2013 GBP 13,006,000 positive) together with a negative development in reinsurance acceptances of GBP  2,813,000 (2013 GBP 4,256,000 positive).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall gross prior year strengthening of GBP 23.233 million in 2014. This adverse development was primarily driven by worse than expected experience in the third party liability class, contributing GBP 20.420 million, and a negative development of GBP 2.813 million in reinsurance acceptances. The strengthening reflected worse than expected experience from general liability and professional indemnity classes.
raw_causal_phrases: overall negative net run-off development of GBP 23,233,000
major contributor was third party liability of GBP 20,420,000 adverse
negative development in reinsurance acceptances of GBP  2,813,000
worse than expected experience from the general liability and professional indemnity classes
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is explicitly stated as 'negative net run-off development' in Note 4, which implies a gross strengthening. The breakdown is also gross. The LOB mapping for lob_movements is based on the syndicate's primary business (casualty).
